_comment: Caller -> chat routing for the session-liveness escalation body (bodies/colab-liveness.md in the scheduler repo). Keys are caller tags from config/callers.json plus 'main' for the main chat. Thread callers route to their own chat; machinery callers (panel, standing, test, lease) and unknown callers fall back to 'main'. The live file (config/notify-routes.json) is untracked operator state; this example is the tracked seed.
